answer.narrative: Campaign C0027 was a financially-motivated campaign linked to Scattered Spider (G1015) that targeted telecommunications and business process outsourcing (BPO) companies from June through December 2022. During the campaign, Scattered Spider used social engineering, performed SIM swapping, and attempted to leverage access from victim environments to mobile carrier networks. The campaign is associated with one software, 18 subtechniques, and 10 techniques.

results.query: MATCH (n:Campaign) WHERE n.attack_id IN $ids OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r]-(m) WITH n, CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE type(r) END AS rel, CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE startNode(r) = n END AS outgoing, CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE head(labels(m)) END AS neighbour_label, count(m) AS cnt WITH n, collect(CASE WHEN rel IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE {rel: rel, outgoing: outgoing, label: neighbour_label, count: cnt} END) AS raw WITH n, [f IN raw WHERE f IS NOT NULL] AS facets RETURN n.attack_id AS id, n.name AS name, n.properties_json AS properties_json, facets AS facets LIMIT 300
